preprocess_chat: preprocess a user chat message by tokenizing and splitting it into sentences for a dialogue manager
word_tokenize: tokenize a chat string using spaCy after inserting spaces around numbers and punctuation
sentence_split: split a chat string into lowercase sentences by normalizing punctuation to periods
insert_spaces: insert spaces between numbers and adjacent brackets or punctuation in a chat string
run_preprocess_cli: run the preprocess module as a CLI to tokenize and split each input line from stdin
